keyword: do you get a new green jacket for every masters win

verifications.claim: Masters winners do not get a new Green Jacket for every win.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Do you get a green jacket for every Masters win? No. Augusta National only awards one green jacket to a Masters champion, even if they've won multiple times.'; R4: 'Repeat Masters winners do not receive a new jacket for each victory.'; R6: 'If you are a previous Masters winner, you always have the same jacket, unless your body size changes.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state that winners do not get a new jacket for every win; they use the same one.

verifications.claim: Masters winners receive a new trophy.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Masters winners also get a beautiful Masters trophy to commemorate their win.'; R6: 'If you win The Masters again, you get a new trophy, and you get to keep the trophy each and every time you win again.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm winners receive a new trophy for each win.

verifications.claim: Multiple winners are generally presented with the same jacket from their initial victory.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: Direct statements confirm repeat winners are presented with the same initial jacket.

verifications.reasoning: Sources state jackets are kept and stored at the club after the one-year period.

verifications.claim: If a player wins back-to-back, they take the same jacket home again.
